### SouthState Bank Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend


October 21, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/481248838/files/content_files/3Q26-Earnings-Release-FINAL.pdf)


WINTER HAVEN, Fla.


, Oct. 21, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SouthState Bank Corporation ("SouthState" or the "Company") (NYSE: SSB) today released its unaudited results of operations and other financial information for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026.


"The third quarter was marked by strong balance sheet growth and a stable net interest margin," said John C. Corbett, SouthState's chief executive officer. "Loans and deposits each grew at a 9% annualized rate, with growth broad-based across our geographies and business lines, and boosted by the bankers we've added over the past year. Asset quality remains favorable, and while capital markets activity softened as treasury yields rose, the core franchise continues to perform well."


Highlights of the third quarter of 2026 include:


**Returns**


- Reported diluted Earnings per Share ("EPS") and Adjusted Diluted EPS (Non-GAAP) of $2.30
- Net Income of $224 million
- Return on Average Common Equity of 9.7%; Return on Average Tangible Common Equity (Non-GAAP) of 16.6%*
- Return on Average Assets ("ROAA") of 1.29%*
- Book Value per Share of $93.51
- Tangible Book Value ("TBV") per Share (Non-GAAP) of $58.19, an increase of 7% year over year, after raising the dividend by 10%, and repurchasing nearly 5% of the Company's shares over the past year


**Performance**


- Net Interest Income of $592 million, an increase of $16 million, or 3%, compared to the prior quarter
- Noninterest Income of $94 million, compared to $97 million in the prior quarter; Noninterest Income represented 0.54%* of average assets, compared to 0.57%* in the prior quarter
- Noninterest Expense of $375 million, an increase of $17 million compared to the prior quarter primarily due to an increase in salaries and employee benefits expense; compensation expense increases were due to July 1 merit increases, successful execution of the revenue producer hiring initiative, higher incentive accruals, and a reduction in deferred loan costs compared to the prior quarter
- Net Interest Margin ("NIM"), non-tax equivalent and tax equivalent (Non-GAAP), of 3.77% and 3.78%, respectively; loan accretion income of $27 million, a decrease of $6 million compared to the prior quarter and a decrease of $56 million year over year
- Net charge-offs totaled $12 million, or 0.09%* of average loans
- $20 million of Provision for Credit Losses ("PCL"); total Allowance for Credit Losses ("ACL") plus reserve for unfunded commitments of 1.29% of loans
- Efficiency Ratio of 52%


**Balance Sheet**


- Loans increased by $1.2 billion, or 9%*, compared to the prior quarter and increased by $4.4 billion, or 9%, year over year; deposits increased by $1.3 billion, or 9%*, and increased by $3.6 billion, or 7%, year over year; ending loan to deposit ratio of 90%
- Total deposit cost of 1.80%, up 0.04% from the prior quarter
- Repurchased a total of 250,000 shares during the quarter at a weighted average price of $104.45
- Strong capital position with Tangible Common Equity, Total Risk-Based Capital, Tier 1 Leverage, and Tier 1 Common Equity ratios of 8.4%, 13.5%, 9.4%, and 11.1%, respectively†


**Subsequent Events**


- The Board of Directors of the Company declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.66 per share, payable on November 13, 2026 to shareholders of record as of November 6, 2026
